headline: JSW Steel and JFE Steel form 50:50 joint venture for Bhushan Power steel business
sum: JSW Steel and Japan-headquartered JFE Steel Corporation announced a 50:50 joint venture to acquire and operate the steel business assets of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited, a distressed company under insolvency resolution. The venture appears to pool JSW's domestic operations expertise with JFE's technology and global steelmaking capability.
detail: JSW Steel and JFE Steel Corporation jointly announced a 50:50 joint venture to acquire the steel business of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited, a company in insolvency. The transaction appears to be structured as a resolution plan approved under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. Bhushan Power operates significant steelmaking capacity; the JV will combine JSW's domestic steel and mining footprint with JFE's advanced technology and operational expertise. Regulatory approvals (CCI, NCLT, sectoral clearances) would be prerequisites for completion.
